using Bdgrz.Compliance.Features.Criteria.Events;
using Cntryl.Portia;

namespace Bdgrz.Compliance.Features.Criteria.Services;

/// <summary>Verifies the immutable facts authorizing one exact label release.</summary>
internal static class CriteriaLabelReleaseRules
{
    internal readonly record struct Authorization(string Reason, Uuid ReplacementConfirmationEventId);

    /// <summary>Validates a terminal operation fence without inferring that a reservation exists.</summary>
    internal static string? AuthorizeFence(Uuid editionId, Uuid operationId, string label,
        DomainEvent intent, DomainEvent terminal)
    {
        if (editionId == Uuid.Empty || operationId == Uuid.Empty || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) ||
            intent.Metadata.EventId == Uuid.Empty || terminal.Metadata.EventId == Uuid.Empty ||
            intent.Metadata.AggregateVersion >= terminal.Metadata.AggregateVersion)
            return null;
        var kind = intent switch
        {
            CriteriaEditionDraftRequested draft when draft.EditionId == editionId &&
                draft.OperationId == operationId && draft.Label == label => "initial",
            CriteriaInitialLabelRequested initial when initial.EditionId == editionId &&
                initial.OperationId == operationId && initial.Label == label => "initial",
            CriteriaEditionRenameRequested rename when rename.EditionId == editionId &&
                rename.OperationId == operationId && rename.NewLabel == label => "rename",
            _ => null,
        };
        return terminal switch
        {
            CriteriaEditionDraftRequestCancelled cancelled when kind == "initial" &&
                cancelled.EditionId == editionId && cancelled.TargetOperationId == operationId &&
                cancelled.OperationId != Uuid.Empty && cancelled.OperationId != operationId &&
                cancelled.ExecutionGeneration > 0 => "cancelled",
            CriteriaEditionRenameCancelled cancelled when kind == "rename" &&
                cancelled.EditionId == editionId && cancelled.RenameOperationId == operationId &&
                cancelled.OperationId != Uuid.Empty && cancelled.OperationId != operationId &&
                cancelled.ExecutionGeneration > 0 => "cancelled",
            CriteriaInitialLabelRefused refused when kind == "initial" && refused.EditionId == editionId &&
                refused.OperationId == operationId && refused.Label == label && refused.RefusalEventId != Uuid.Empty &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(refused.Reason) => "refused",
            CriteriaEditionRenameRefused refused when kind == "rename" && refused.EditionId == editionId &&
                refused.OperationId == operationId && refused.RefusalEventId != Uuid.Empty &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(refused.Reason) => "refused",
            _ => null,
        };
    }

    internal static Authorization? Authorize(EditionLabelReserved reservation, DomainEvent intent,
        DomainEvent terminal, CriteriaEditionDraftRenamed? rename = null,
        EditionLabelConfirmed? replacementConfirmation = null,
        EditionLabelReserved? replacementReservation = null, CriteriaEditionRenameRequested? renameIntent = null)
    {
        if (reservation.Metadata.EventId == Uuid.Empty || reservation.EditionId == Uuid.Empty ||
            reservation.OperationId == Uuid.Empty || reservation.Generation <= 0 ||
            reservation.EditionRequestEventId == Uuid.Empty ||
            intent.Metadata.EventId != reservation.EditionRequestEventId || terminal.Metadata.EventId == Uuid.Empty ||
            intent.Metadata.AggregateVersion >= terminal.Metadata.AggregateVersion ||
            !MatchesIntent(reservation, intent))
            return null;

        return terminal switch
        {
            CriteriaEditionDraftRequestCancelled cancelled when
                intent is CriteriaEditionDraftRequested or CriteriaInitialLabelRequested &&
                cancelled.EditionId == reservation.EditionId && cancelled.TargetOperationId == reservation.OperationId &&
                cancelled.OperationId != Uuid.Empty && cancelled.OperationId != cancelled.TargetOperationId &&
                cancelled.ExecutionGeneration > 0 =>
                new("cancelled", Uuid.Empty),
            CriteriaEditionRenameCancelled cancelled when intent is CriteriaEditionRenameRequested &&
                cancelled.EditionId == reservation.EditionId && cancelled.RenameOperationId == reservation.OperationId &&
                cancelled.OperationId != Uuid.Empty && cancelled.OperationId != cancelled.RenameOperationId &&
                cancelled.ExecutionGeneration > 0 =>
                new("cancelled", Uuid.Empty),
            CriteriaInitialLabelRefused refused when
                intent is CriteriaEditionDraftRequested or CriteriaInitialLabelRequested &&
                refused.EditionId == reservation.EditionId && refused.OperationId == reservation.OperationId &&
                refused.Label == reservation.Label && refused.RefusalEventId != Uuid.Empty &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(refused.Reason) => new("refused", Uuid.Empty),
            CriteriaEditionRenameRefused refused when intent is CriteriaEditionRenameRequested &&
                refused.EditionId == reservation.EditionId && refused.OperationId == reservation.OperationId &&
                refused.RefusalEventId != Uuid.Empty && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(refused.Reason) =>
                new("refused", Uuid.Empty),
            CriteriaEditionDraftAbandoned abandoned when abandoned.EditionId == reservation.EditionId &&
                abandoned.Label == reservation.Label && abandoned.LabelGeneration == reservation.Generation &&
                abandoned.OperationId != Uuid.Empty && abandoned.DraftGeneration != Uuid.Empty &&
                abandoned.ExecutionGeneration > 0 =>
                new("abandoned", Uuid.Empty),
            CriteriaEditionRenameCompleted completed when MatchesReplacement(reservation, completed, rename,
                replacementConfirmation, replacementReservation, renameIntent) =>
                new("renamed", completed.ConfirmationEventId),
            _ => null,
        };
    }

    static bool MatchesIntent(EditionLabelReserved reservation, DomainEvent intent) => intent switch
    {
        CriteriaEditionDraftRequested draft => draft.EditionId == reservation.EditionId &&
            draft.OperationId == reservation.OperationId && draft.Label == reservation.Label &&
            draft.Actor == reservation.RequestedBy,
        CriteriaInitialLabelRequested initial => initial.EditionId == reservation.EditionId &&
            initial.OperationId == reservation.OperationId && initial.Label == reservation.Label &&
            initial.Actor == reservation.RequestedBy,
        CriteriaEditionRenameRequested request => request.EditionId == reservation.EditionId &&
            request.OperationId == reservation.OperationId && request.NewLabel == reservation.Label &&
            request.Actor == reservation.RequestedBy,
        _ => false,
    };

    static bool MatchesReplacement(EditionLabelReserved old, CriteriaEditionRenameCompleted completed,
        CriteriaEditionDraftRenamed? rename, EditionLabelConfirmed? confirmation,
        EditionLabelReserved? reservation, CriteriaEditionRenameRequested? intent) =>
        rename is not null && confirmation is not null && reservation is not null && intent is not null &&
        rename.Metadata.EventId != Uuid.Empty &&
        confirmation.Metadata.EventId == completed.ConfirmationEventId &&
        reservation.Metadata.EventId == rename.ReservationEventId &&
        reservation.Metadata.AggregateVersion < confirmation.Metadata.AggregateVersion &&
        reservation.EditionRequestEventId == intent.Metadata.EventId &&
        MatchesIntent(reservation, intent) && intent.OldLabel == old.Label &&
        intent.OldLabelGeneration == old.Generation &&
        intent.Metadata.AggregateVersion < rename.Metadata.AggregateVersion &&
        rename.Metadata.AggregateVersion < completed.Metadata.AggregateVersion &&
        completed.EditionId == old.EditionId && rename.EditionId == old.EditionId &&
        rename.OperationId == completed.OperationId && rename.OldLabel == old.Label &&
        rename.OldLabelGeneration == old.Generation && rename.NewLabel == completed.Label &&
        rename.NewLabelGeneration == completed.LabelGeneration &&
        confirmation.EditionId == old.EditionId && confirmation.OperationId == completed.OperationId &&
        confirmation.Label == completed.Label && confirmation.Generation == completed.LabelGeneration &&
        reservation.EditionId == old.EditionId && reservation.OperationId == completed.OperationId &&
        reservation.Label == completed.Label && reservation.Generation == completed.LabelGeneration &&
        confirmation.EditionAcceptedEventId == rename.Metadata.EventId;
}
state.design:
# Criteria label intake and summary no-op follow-up

Status: **design direction; neither protocol is fully implemented**. Label
reservation fences and exact-source release handlers are authored but are not
registered as complete orchestration. A same-text summary correction currently
returns pending because no durable exact-intent receipt exists.

## Independent label signals

Each relevant committed edition or label fact needs a recoverable signal. A
source-facing reactor can create one deterministic process record for the exact
source stream and event ID, then advance its checkpoint after that record is
durable. It must not wait at the shared checkpoint for a contested label. The
existing `ProcessSweep` can discover due records in bounded pages and isolate
failures, provided the label process is registered with `ProcessCatalog` and a
receiver is supplied. These records are independent coordination state, not a
roster in an edition or claim aggregate.

`ProcessRootReaction.StartAsync` cannot be used directly: it accepts only
`INativeOperationFact` roots, while the existing criteria edition and label
participant events are ordinary domain events. A source-specific intake must
verify the trigger's actual stream, aggregate and event metadata; freeze a small
immutable payload; create a deterministic `ProcessRecord` with an exact source
reference; and confirm that any existing record has the same source and intent.
The driver requires a typed `IRequest<ReceiverOutcome>` adapter for its steps;
the current label commands return `IRequest` instead. Creation uncertainty must
not permit a checkpoint to advance unless the record is observed or a durable
create outcome is otherwise established.

Trigger both sides of each transition: edition requests and participant
reservations; edition activations or renames and participant confirmations;
and edition cancellations, refusals, abandonment or completed renames. A
participant can arrive after an edition terminal fact, so the terminal path
must establish the selected claim's target-side request fence rather than treat
an unobserved reservation as absent. If the reserve wins the claim append race,
the fence retries and releases that exact generation; if the fence wins, a
stale reservation cannot rebase across it. An unrelated holder remains intact.
For a completed rename, release the old claim only after checking the exact new
reservation, rename intent and decision, and new-label confirmation. Expired or
compacted source must remain unresolved unless retention and lineage are
qualified. Source events, not the discovery index, authorize decisions.

The source intake, receiver adaptation, and process definition are still open.
The process store's due-time paging, CAS, sync durability, unknown-commit
recovery, and source-to-record reconciliation must be qualified on the actual
provider before this is relied on. A failed signal must remain independently
retryable; a permanently pending signal must not block unrelated operations.
These requirements are not established merely by having an in-memory queue or
by registering the existing synchronous realm-wide reactors.

## Same-text summary correction

Persisting a receipt only for no-op summaries is unsafe: a concurrent structural
operation could use the same `(edition, identifier, operationId)` in the entry
stream while a different intent wins the receipt stream. Both could then appear
accepted. All entry operations must first compete to create the same
operation-scoped immutable intent, binding normalized intent, actor, target and
admission. Exact retries compare it; changed-intent reuse conflicts. This owner
contains one intent and one terminal outcome, not a list of children or retries.

For a same-text summary, first durably establish the operation intent. Then
obtain a qualified current observation of the exact entry revision and summary.
That observation can be the no-op's linearization point, after which a single
`no change` outcome is recorded in the operation owner. The outcome records the
source position and evidence required to verify the observation; it must not
claim that the summary changed. A concurrent later entry change does not
retroactively change that earlier no-op decision. A missing or unqualified
fresh-head certificate leaves the operation pending. A timed-out receipt append
is resolved by exact source replay or a target-side fence; it is never assumed to
have failed. Current authorization is still required before retry results are
disclosed.

The existing `ICriteriaFreshEntryHead` has no qualified production provider, and
the current structural and summary paths do not share an operation identity
claim. Until both are implemented and race-tested, leave the no-op pending; a
separate no-op-only receipt would introduce an idempotency hole.
state.premises: All writes for one label append with the observed expected source position. Every mutation selects its exact edition and operation. Source-verifying handlers verify exact immutable source facts. Portia loads the full event stream and ordinary reads are not qualified fresh-head proof.

fence_blocks.instructions: If the exact terminal fence commits before a delayed reservation at the same expected position, should a later rehydrated reservation for that operation succeed?

reserve_wins.instructions: If the reservation commits before the fence, must the fence operation release that exact held reservation rather than treat it as absent?

other_holder.instructions: Can fencing one edition operation by itself release an unrelated current holder?

changed_terminal.instructions: Should an existing fence accept a different terminal event ID as an exact retry?

late_confirmation.instructions: Does an already released reservation become held again merely because an old confirmation is retried?

receipt_bypass.instructions: Can a same-summary no-op-only receipt safely share an operation ID with structural entry operations if structural operations do not use that receipt identity claim?

unqualified_head.instructions: Does a quiet read page after an ambiguous commit prove a fresh source head?

non_native_root.instructions: Can the existing ProcessRootReaction start a record directly from an ordinary DomainEvent that does not implement INativeOperationFact?

checkpoint_wait.instructions: Does synchronously waiting on a contested claim allow unrelated work behind the same ordered checkpoint to advance?
